## 1181282c-e4e5-4686-91d6-7d9e5e392fce
Mintlify Admin MCP — read, edit, and manage documentation deployments.

There are two ways to work, depending on the task:
- EDIT DOCS CONTENT (pages, navigation, MDX bodies, docs.json): use the session-based tools after checkout. Changes land on an isolated branch and ship via save (a PR or a commit) — nothing goes live until then.
- MANAGE A DEPLOYMENT (workflows, deployment settings, members, billing, integrations, analytics): use code mode (execute_code). No checkout needed, and these writes apply IMMEDIATELY to the live deployment — there is no branch/PR safety net.

== Editing docs content ==
1. list_deployments — discover which deployment(s) this connection can access. Skip if the connection is pinned to one deployment or you already know the subdomain.
2. checkout {subdomain} — REQUIRED before any content tool. Opens an editing session/branch and returns editorUrl (surface it to the user) plus a toolkit map grouping the tools to use next. read, search, list_nodes, diff, get_session_state, edit_page, write_page, create_node, update_node, move_node, delete_node, and update_config all operate on this session and fail with "No active session" until you checkout. (~7s — expect a pause.)
3. Edit:
   - Create a page or navigation entry -> create_node.
   - Edit an MDX body -> edit_page (string-replace) or write_page (full overwrite).
   - Page frontmatter (title, sidebarTitle, description, icon, noindex, ...) and nav-node properties -> update_node with data.type='page'. Do NOT use edit_page for frontmatter.
   - Site config in docs.json -> update_config.
4. save — publishes the session. Defaults to mode:'auto': opens a PR and, when the deployment's agent review setting is push-to-main and the deploy branch is unprotected, merges it immediately (returns merged: true); otherwise the PR stays open. mode:'pr' always leaves the PR open for review. If the branch already has an open PR, saves commit to that branch instead. Use discard_session to abandon the session. (~10s.)

## persome
# Persome — the user's local personal memory

Persome is private local memory: durable facts plus recent screen activity. Query it before asking the user to repeat context or guessing.

## When to use (decision rule)

Call Persome before clarifying or saying "I don't know" when the request may depend on context outside this chat:

- ambiguous references: "this", "that", "it", "the bug", "the file", "the doc"
- present tense: "what am I working on", "what's open on my screen"
- recency: "yesterday", "last week", "earlier", "continue what I was doing"
- prior project / person / tool context: "introduce my project"
- personalization: "write it the way I usually do"
- cross-session continuity, recent decisions, ongoing work

A missed lookup is worse than an extra one: tools are local and cheap; `[]` / `null` is still information. Skip only for fully specified in-chat requests or live external state.

## Tool routing

- who the user is / how they work / match their style → `behavior_patterns()`
- who X is / how X relates to people & projects → `entity_graph(name)`
- what happened / was decided / durable facts → `search(query)` — semantic, paraphrase ok
- is this still true (versions, status, schedules) → `verify_fact(claim)`
- what the user is doing right now / ambiguous pronoun → `current_context()`
- exact string seen or typed on screen (errors, URLs, code) → `search_captures(query)`, then `read_recent_capture(...)`
- what the user has been up to lately → `recent_activity()`; focus/time spent → `attention_trajectory()`
- browse files → `list_memories()` / `read_memory(path)`
- audit/context around a memory or model claim → `resolve_evidence(reference)` / `read_receipt(entry_id)` / `related_events(entry_id)`
- the user corrects a wrong memory → `correct_memory(correction)`; a durable new finding → `remember(content)`
- unsure between compressed vs raw → `search` and `search_captures` in parallel

2	//  BatchExplanationController.swift
3	//  SwiftMandarin
4	//
5	//  Independent, resumable-by-cache batch queues for AI explanations and
6	//  persistent MiniMax pronunciation audio.
7	//
8	
9	import CryptoKit
10	import Foundation
11	import Observation
12	
13	nonisolated enum BatchCredentialFingerprint {
14	    static func make(_ credential: String) -> String {
15	        let normalized = credential.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
16	        guard !normalized.isEmpty else { return "no-credential" }
17	        return SHA256.hash(data: Data(normalized.utf8))
18	            .map { String(format: "%02x", $0) }
19	            .joined()
20	    }
21	}
22	
23	/// An in-memory, secret-free identity for every mutable AI request setting
24	/// used by word explanations. The service can continue to own request
25	/// construction, while a reviewed batch refuses to mix models, accounts,
26	/// endpoints, formats, or local-Ollama options mid-run.
27	nonisolated struct BatchAnalysisConfigurationSnapshot: Equatable, Sendable {
28	    let providerRawValue: String
29	    let providerName: String
30	    let modelID: String
31	    let endpointIdentity: String
32	    let optionsIdentity: String
33	    let credentialFingerprint: String
34	
35	    @MainActor
36	    static func current() -> Self {
37	        let settings = AIModelSettings.shared
38	        let provider = settings.effectiveProvider
39	        let modelID = settings.selectedModel(for: provider)
40	
41	        switch provider {
42	        case .appleIntelligence:
43	            return Self(
44	                providerRawValue: provider.rawValue,
45	                providerName: provider.displayName,
46	                modelID: modelID,
47	                endpointIdentity: "on-device",
48	                optionsIdentity: "foundation-models",
49	                credentialFingerprint: "no-credential"
50	            )
51	        case .ollama:
52	            return Self(
53	                providerRawValue: provider.rawValue,
54	                providerName: provider.displayName,
55	                modelID: modelID,
56	                endpointIdentity: OllamaService.shared.hostURL.absoluteString,
57	                optionsIdentity: "thinking=\(settings.enableThinking);context=\(settings.contextLength)",
58	                credentialFingerprint: "no-credential"
59	            )
60	        default:
61	            let style: String
62	            switch settings.effectiveAPIStyle(for: provider) {
63	            case .openAICompatible: style = "openai"
64	            case .anthropic: style = "anthropic"
65	            }
66	            return Self(
67	                providerRawValue: provider.rawValue,
68	                providerName: provider.displayName,
69	                modelID: modelID,
70	                endpointIdentity: settings.baseURL(for: provider)
71	                    + "\u{1}" + settings.effectiveChatPath(for: provider),
72	                optionsIdentity: style,
73	                credentialFingerprint: BatchCredentialFingerprint.make(
74	                    settings.apiKey(for: provider)
75	                )
76	            )
77	        }
78	    }
79	
80	    @MainActor
81	    func matchesCurrentSettings() -> Bool {
82	        self == Self.current()
83	    }
84	}
85	
86	nonisolated struct BatchAnalysisTarget: Hashable, Sendable {
87	    let word: String
88	    let pinyin: String
89	    let context: String?
90	    let directionToken: String
91	}
92	
93	nonisolated struct BatchRunPlan: Sendable, Identifiable {
94	    let id: UUID
95	    let analysisTargets: [BatchAnalysisTarget]
96	    let analysisConfiguration: BatchAnalysisConfigurationSnapshot
97	    let audioPlan: BatchAudioPlan?
98	    let audioLearningIsChinese: Bool?
99	    let audioCredentialFingerprint: String?
100	
101	    var analysisCount: Int { analysisTargets.count }
102	    var newAudioCount: Int { audioPlan?.newClipCount ?? 0 }
103	    var cachedAudioCount: Int { audioPlan?.cachedClipCount ?? 0 }
104	    var totalAudioCount: Int { audioPlan?.totalClipCount ?? 0 }
105	    var totalNewAudioCharacters: Int { audioPlan?.totalNewCharacters ?? 0 }
106	    var hasWork: Bool { analysisCount > 0 || newAudioCount > 0 }
107	}
108	
109	nonisolated struct BatchRunSummary: Equatable, Sendable {
110	    let analysesGenerated: Int
111	    let analysesFailed: Int
112	    let analysesSkipped: Int
113	    let analysesUnattempted: Int
114	    let audioGenerated: Int
115	    let audioCached: Int
116	    let audioFailed: Int
117	    let audioUnattempted: Int
118	}
119	
120	@Observable
121	@MainActor
122	final class BatchExplanationController {
123	    static let shared = BatchExplanationController()
124	
125	    enum RunPhase: Equatable {
126	        case analyzing
127	        case generatingAudio
128	    }
129	
130	    enum Status: Equatable {
131	        case idle
132	        case running(RunPhase)
133	        case finished(BatchRunSummary)
134	        case cancelled(BatchRunSummary)
135	        case failed(BatchRunSummary)
136	    }
137	
138	    private(set) var status: Status = .idle
139	
140	    private(set) var analysisTotal = 0
141	    private(set) var analysesGenerated = 0
142	    private(set) var analysesFailed = 0
143	    private(set) var analysesSkipped = 0
144	
145	    private(set) var audioTotal = 0
146	    private(set) var audioGenerated = 0
147	    private(set) var audioCached = 0
148	    private(set) var audioFailed = 0
149	
150	    private(set) var lastWord: String?
151	    private(set) var lastErrorMessage: String?
152	
153	    private var task: Task<Void, Never>?
154	    private var userRequestedCancellation = false
155	    private var stoppedByFailure = false
156	
157	    private init() {}
158	
159	    var isRunning: Bool {
160	        if case .running = status { return true }
161	        return false
162	    }
163	
164	    var currentPhase: RunPhase? {
165	        if case let .running(phase) = status { return phase }
166	        return nil
167	    }
168	
169	    var analysisProcessed: Int {
170	        analysesGenerated + analysesFailed + analysesSkipped
171	    }
172	
173	    var audioProcessed: Int {
174	        audioGenerated + audioCached + audioFailed
175	    }
176	
177	    var total: Int { analysisTotal + audioTotal }
178	    var processed: Int { analysisProcessed + audioProcessed }
179	
180	    var progress: Double {
181	        guard total > 0 else { return 0 }
182	        return min(1, Double(processed) / Double(total))
183	    }
184	
185	    var analysisProgress: Double {
186	        guard analysisTotal > 0 else { return 1 }
187	        return min(1, Double(analysisProcessed) / Double(analysisTotal))
188	    }
189	
190	    var audioProgress: Double {
191	        guard audioTotal > 0 else { return 1 }
192	        return min(1, Double(audioProcessed) / Double(audioTotal))
193	    }
194	
195	    func unprocessedTerms(from terms: [SavedTerm]) -> [SavedTerm] {
196	        let cache = WordExplanationCacheStore.shared
197	        return terms.filter { term in
198	            let word = term.headlineText
199	            guard !word.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).isEmpty else { return false }
200	            let token = ExplanationDirection.current(forWord: word).cacheToken
201	            return !cache.hasExplanation(forWord: word, directionToken: token)
202	        }
203	    }
204	
205	    func remainingCount(from terms: [SavedTerm]) -> Int {
206	        unprocessedTerms(from: terms).count
207	    }
208	
209	    /// Builds an exact, credential-free paid-request preflight. Explanation
210	    /// and audio queues are independent, so an audio-only run remains possible
211	    /// after every word has already been analyzed.
212	    func preparePlan(
213	        from terms: [SavedTerm],
214	        includeAudio: Bool,
215	        audioScope: BatchAudioScope
216	    ) async throws -> BatchRunPlan {
217	        let sorted = terms.sorted { $0.dateAdded > $1.dateAdded }
218	        let explanationCache = WordExplanationCacheStore.shared
219	        let nativeIsChinese = LocalizationManager.shared.nativeIsChinese
220	        let learningIsChinese = LocalizationManager.shared.learningIsChinese
221	        let analysisConfiguration = BatchAnalysisConfigurationSnapshot.current()
222	        var seenAnalyses = Set<String>()
223	        var analysisTargets: [BatchAnalysisTarget] = []
224	        var audioSnapshots: [BatchAudioTermSnapshot] = []
225	
226	        for term in sorted {
227	            let word = term.headlineText.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
228	            if !word.isEmpty {
229	                let token = ExplanationDirection(
230	                    wordIsChinese: word.containsCJK,
231	                    explainInChinese: nativeIsChinese
232	                ).cacheToken
233	                let analysisID = token + "\u{1}" + word.folding(
234	                    options: [.caseInsensitive, .diacriticInsensitive, .widthInsensitive],
235	                    locale: Locale(identifier: "en_US_POSIX")
236	                )
237	                if !explanationCache.hasExplanation(forWord: word, directionToken: token),
238	                   seenAnalyses.insert(analysisID).inserted {
239	                    analysisTargets.append(
240	                        BatchAnalysisTarget(
241	                            word: word,
242	                            // The reading is a sense hint for `word`, so it
243	                            // must belong to the side that became the headword
244	                            // — a Chinese-side pinyin is noise under an
245	                            // English headword in reverse mode.
246	                            pinyin: term.headwordReading,
247	                            context: term.glossText.isEmpty ? nil : term.glossText,
248	                            directionToken: token
249	                        )
250	                    )
251	                }
252	            }
253	
254	            if includeAudio {
255	                audioSnapshots.append(
256	                    BatchAudioTermSnapshot(
257	                        termID: term.id,
258	                        displayWord: word.isEmpty ? term.chinese : word,
259	                        chineseText: term.chineseSide,
260	                        englishText: term.englishSide
261	                    )
262	                )
263	            }
264	        }
265	
266	        let audioPlan: BatchAudioPlan?
267	        if includeAudio {
268	            let preferences = AppPreferences.shared
269	            let chineseConfiguration = preferences.miniMaxSpeechConfiguration(languageCode: "zh-CN")
270	            let englishConfiguration = preferences.miniMaxSpeechConfiguration(languageCode: "en-US")
271	            let uncachedPlan = BatchAudioPlanner.makePlan(
272	                terms: audioSnapshots,
273	                scope: audioScope,
274	                learningIsChinese: learningIsChinese,
275	                chineseConfiguration: chineseConfiguration,
276	                englishConfiguration: englishConfiguration,
277	                existingRecordIDs: []
278	            )
279	            let existing = try await GeneratedSpeechRepository.shared.existingRecordIDs(
280	                among: Set(uncachedPlan.allTargets.map(\.id))
281	            )
282	            audioPlan = BatchAudioPlanner.makePlan(
283	                terms: audioSnapshots,
284	                scope: audioScope,
285	                learningIsChinese: learningIsChinese,
286	                chineseConfiguration: chineseConfiguration,
287	                englishConfiguration: englishConfiguration,
288	                existingRecordIDs: existing
289	            )
290	        } else {
291	            audioPlan = nil
292	        }
293	
294	        return BatchRunPlan(
295	            id: UUID(),
296	            analysisTargets: analysisTargets,
297	            analysisConfiguration: analysisConfiguration,
298	            audioPlan: audioPlan,
299	            audioLearningIsChinese: includeAudio ? learningIsChinese : nil,
300	            audioCredentialFingerprint: includeAudio
301	                ? BatchCredentialFingerprint.make(
302	                    AIModelSettings.shared.apiKey(for: .minimax)
303	                )
304	                : nil
305	        )
306	    }

308	    func start(plan: BatchRunPlan, concurrency: Int) {
309	        guard !isRunning else { return }
310	
311	        let settings = AIModelSettings.shared
312	        if plan.analysisCount > 0, !settings.isAnyProviderAvailable {
313	            resetCounters(for: plan)
314	            lastErrorMessage = String(localized: "No AI provider is configured. Add one in Settings → AI (or run a local Ollama server).", bundle: .appLanguage)
315	            status = .failed(summary())
316	            return
317	        }
318	
319	        if plan.analysisCount > 0,
320	           !plan.analysisConfiguration.matchesCurrentSettings() {
321	            resetCounters(for: plan)
322	            lastErrorMessage = String(localized: "AI settings changed after this batch was reviewed. Review the batch again before starting.", bundle: .appLanguage)
323	            status = .failed(summary())
324	            return
325	        }
326	
327	        if plan.analysisTargets.contains(where: {
328	            ExplanationDirection.current(forWord: $0.word).cacheToken != $0.directionToken
329	        }) {
330	            resetCounters(for: plan)
331	            lastErrorMessage = String(localized: "Language settings changed after this batch was reviewed. Review the batch again before starting.", bundle: .appLanguage)
332	            status = .failed(summary())
333	            return
334	        }
335	
336	        if plan.audioPlan?.scope == .learningLanguage,
337	           plan.audioLearningIsChinese != LocalizationManager.shared.learningIsChinese {
338	            resetCounters(for: plan)
339	            lastErrorMessage = String(localized: "Language settings changed after this batch was reviewed. Review the batch again before starting.", bundle: .appLanguage)
340	            status = .failed(summary())
341	            return
342	        }
343	
344	        let apiKey = plan.newAudioCount > 0 ? settings.apiKey(for: .minimax) : ""
345	        if plan.newAudioCount > 0,
346	           apiKey.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).isEmpty {
347	            resetCounters(for: plan)
348	            lastErrorMessage = String(localized: "Add a MiniMax API key in AI Audio settings before generating batch audio.", bundle: .appLanguage)
349	            status = .failed(summary())
350	            return
351	        }
352	        if plan.newAudioCount > 0,
353	           plan.audioCredentialFingerprint != BatchCredentialFingerprint.make(apiKey) {
354	            resetCounters(for: plan)
355	            lastErrorMessage = String(localized: "The MiniMax API key changed after this batch was reviewed. Review the batch again before starting.", bundle: .appLanguage)
356	            status = .failed(summary())
357	            return
358	        }
359	
360	        let analysisLimit = min(
361	            max(concurrency, AIModelSettings.batchConcurrencyRange.lowerBound),
362	            AIModelSettings.batchConcurrencyRange.upperBound
363	        )
364	        resetCounters(for: plan)
365	        guard plan.hasWork else {
366	            status = .finished(summary())
367	            return
368	        }
369	
370	        status = .running(plan.analysisCount > 0 ? .analyzing : .generatingAudio)
371	        task = Task { [weak self] in
372	            await self?.run(
373	                plan: plan,
374	                analysisConcurrency: analysisLimit,
375	                apiKey: apiKey,
376	                analysisConfiguration: plan.analysisConfiguration
377	            )
378	        }
379	    }
380	
381	    func cancel() {
382	        userRequestedCancellation = true
383	        task?.cancel()
384	    }
385	
386	    private func resetCounters(for plan: BatchRunPlan) {
387	        analysisTotal = plan.analysisCount
388	        analysesGenerated = 0
389	        analysesFailed = 0
390	        analysesSkipped = 0
391	        audioTotal = plan.totalAudioCount
392	        audioGenerated = 0
393	        audioCached = plan.cachedAudioCount
394	        audioFailed = 0
395	        lastWord = nil
396	        lastErrorMessage = nil
397	        userRequestedCancellation = false
398	        stoppedByFailure = false
399	    }
400	
401	    private func run(
402	        plan: BatchRunPlan,
403	        analysisConcurrency: Int,
404	        apiKey: String,
405	        analysisConfiguration: BatchAnalysisConfigurationSnapshot
406	    ) async {
407	        let runtimeAudioPlan: BatchAudioPlan?
408	        do {
409	            if let reviewedAudioPlan = plan.audioPlan {
410	                let existing = try await GeneratedSpeechRepository.shared.existingRecordIDs(
411	                    among: Set(reviewedAudioPlan.allTargets.map(\.id))
412	                )
413	                runtimeAudioPlan = try BatchAudioPlanRevalidator.revalidate(
414	                    reviewed: reviewedAudioPlan,
415	                    existingRecordIDs: existing
416	                )
417	                audioCached = runtimeAudioPlan?.cachedClipCount ?? 0
418	            } else {
419	                runtimeAudioPlan = nil
420	            }
421	        } catch is CancellationError {
422	            finish()
423	            return
424	        } catch {
425	            stoppedByFailure = true
426	            lastErrorMessage = error.localizedDescription
427	            finish()
428	            return
429	        }
430	
431	        if Task.isCancelled {
432	            finish()
433	            return
434	        }
435	
436	        if !plan.analysisTargets.isEmpty {
437	            await runAnalyses(
438	                plan.analysisTargets,
439	                concurrency: analysisConcurrency,
440	                analysisConfiguration: analysisConfiguration
441	            )
442	        }
443	
444	        if !Task.isCancelled,
445	           let audioPlan = runtimeAudioPlan,
446	           !audioPlan.pendingTargets.isEmpty {
447	            status = .running(.generatingAudio)
448	            await runAudio(
449	                audioPlan.pendingTargets,
450	                apiKey: apiKey,
451	                credentialFingerprint: plan.audioCredentialFingerprint
452	                    ?? BatchCredentialFingerprint.make(apiKey)
453	            )
454	        }
455	
456	        finish()
457	    }
458	
459	    private enum AnalysisOutcome: Sendable {
460	        case generated(word: String)
461	        case failed(word: String, message: String, stopRemaining: Bool)
462	        case skipped
463	        case cancelled
464	    }
465	
466	    private func runAnalyses(
467	        _ targets: [BatchAnalysisTarget],
468	        concurrency: Int,
469	        analysisConfiguration: BatchAnalysisConfigurationSnapshot
470	    ) async {
471	        await withTaskGroup(of: AnalysisOutcome.self) { group in
472	            var nextIndex = 0
473	
474	            func addTaskIfPossible() {
475	                guard nextIndex < targets.count, !Task.isCancelled else { return }
476	                let target = targets[nextIndex]
477	                nextIndex += 1
478	                group.addTask {
479	                    await Self.processAnalysis(
480	                        target,
481	                        analysisConfiguration: analysisConfiguration
482	                    )
483	                }
484	            }
485	
486	            for _ in 0..<concurrency { addTaskIfPossible() }
487	            while let outcome = await group.next() {
488	                apply(outcome)
489	                if Task.isCancelled {
490	                    group.cancelAll()
491	                } else {
492	                    addTaskIfPossible()
493	                }
494	            }
495	        }
496	    }
497	
498	    @MainActor
499	    private static func processAnalysis(
500	        _ target: BatchAnalysisTarget,
501	        analysisConfiguration: BatchAnalysisConfigurationSnapshot
502	    ) async -> AnalysisOutcome {
503	        if Task.isCancelled { return .cancelled }
504	        guard analysisConfiguration.matchesCurrentSettings(),
505	              ExplanationDirection.current(forWord: target.word).cacheToken == target.directionToken else {
506	            return .failed(
507	                word: target.word,
508	                message: String(localized: "AI or language settings changed while the batch was running. Start a new reviewed batch to continue.", bundle: .appLanguage),
509	                stopRemaining: true
510	            )
511	        }
512	        let cache = WordExplanationCacheStore.shared
513	        if cache.hasExplanation(forWord: target.word, directionToken: target.directionToken) {
514	            return .skipped
515	        }
516	
517	        do {
518	            let result = try await AIWordExplanationService.shared.generateExplanationWithProvider(
519	                for: target.word,
520	                pinyin: target.pinyin,
521	                context: target.context
522	            )
523	            if Task.isCancelled { return .cancelled }
524	            guard analysisConfiguration.matchesCurrentSettings(),
525	                  ExplanationDirection.current(forWord: target.word).cacheToken == target.directionToken else {
526	                return .failed(
527	                    word: target.word,
528	                    message: String(localized: "AI or language settings changed while the batch was running. The completed response was not cached under stale settings.", bundle: .appLanguage),
529	                    stopRemaining: true
530	                )
531	            }
532	            cache.store(
533	                word: target.word,
534	                pinyin: target.pinyin,
535	                directionToken: target.directionToken,
536	                providerName: analysisConfiguration.providerName,
537	                result: result
538	            )
539	            return .generated(word: target.word)
540	        } catch is CancellationError {
541	            return .cancelled
542	        } catch {
543	            if Task.isCancelled { return .cancelled }
544	            return .failed(
545	                word: target.word,
546	                message: error.localizedDescription,
547	                stopRemaining: false
548	            )
549	        }
550	    }
551	
552	    private func apply(_ outcome: AnalysisOutcome) {
553	        switch outcome {
554	        case let .generated(word):
555	            analysesGenerated += 1
556	            lastWord = word
557	        case let .failed(word, message, stopRemaining):
558	            analysesFailed += 1
559	            lastWord = word
560	            lastErrorMessage = message
561	            if stopRemaining {
562	                stopForFailure()
563	            }
564	        case .skipped:
565	            analysesSkipped += 1
566	        case .cancelled:
567	            break
568	        }
569	    }
570	
571	    private enum AudioOutcome: Sendable {
572	        case generated(record: GeneratedSpeechRecord, word: String, wasCached: Bool)
573	        case failed(word: String, message: String, stopRemaining: Bool)
574	        case cancelled
575	    }
576	
577	    private func runAudio(
578	        _ targets: [BatchAudioTarget],
579	        apiKey: String,
580	        credentialFingerprint: String
581	    ) async {
582	        let gate = BatchAudioStartGate()
583	        await withTaskGroup(of: AudioOutcome.self) { group in
584	            var nextIndex = 0
585	            let concurrency = min(2, targets.count)
586	
587	            func addTaskIfPossible() {
588	                guard nextIndex < targets.count, !Task.isCancelled else { return }
589	                let target = targets[nextIndex]
590	                nextIndex += 1
591	                group.addTask {
592	                    await Self.processAudio(
593	                        target,
594	                        apiKey: apiKey,
595	                        credentialFingerprint: credentialFingerprint,
596	                        gate: gate
597	                    )
598	                }
599	            }
600	
601	            for _ in 0..<concurrency { addTaskIfPossible() }
602	            while let outcome = await group.next() {
603	                apply(outcome)
604	                if Task.isCancelled {
605	                    group.cancelAll()
606	                } else {
607	                    addTaskIfPossible()
608	                }
609	            }
610	        }
611	    }
612	
613	    @MainActor
614	    private static func processAudio(
615	        _ target: BatchAudioTarget,
616	        apiKey: String,
617	        credentialFingerprint: String,
618	        gate: BatchAudioStartGate
619	    ) async -> AudioOutcome {
620	        if Task.isCancelled { return .cancelled }
621	        do {
622	            try await gate.waitForPermit()
623	            guard credentialFingerprint == BatchCredentialFingerprint.make(apiKey),
624	                  credentialFingerprint == BatchCredentialFingerprint.make(
625	                    AIModelSettings.shared.apiKey(for: .minimax)
626	                  ) else {
627	                return .failed(
628	                    word: target.displayWord,
629	                    message: String(localized: "The MiniMax API key changed while the batch was running. Start a new reviewed batch to continue.", bundle: .appLanguage),
630	                    stopRemaining: true
631	                )
632	            }
633	            let generated = try await MiniMaxSpeechPipeline.shared.speech(
634	                for: target.identity,
635	                apiKey: apiKey
636	            )
637	            GeneratedSpeechStore.shared.note(generated.record)
638	            return .generated(
639	                record: generated.record,
640	                word: target.displayWord,
641	                wasCached: generated.wasCached
642	            )
643	        } catch is CancellationError {
644	            return .cancelled
645	        } catch MiniMaxAudioError.cancelled {
646	            return .cancelled
647	        } catch {
648	            if Task.isCancelled { return .cancelled }
649	            return .failed(
650	                word: target.displayWord,
651	                message: error.localizedDescription,
652	                stopRemaining: BatchAudioFailurePolicy.shouldStop(after: error)
653	            )
654	        }
655	    }
656	
657	    private func apply(_ outcome: AudioOutcome) {
658	        switch outcome {
659	        case let .generated(_, word, wasCached):
660	            if wasCached {
661	                audioCached += 1
662	            } else {
663	                audioGenerated += 1
664	            }
665	            lastWord = word
666	        case let .failed(word, message, stopRemaining):
667	            audioFailed += 1
668	            lastWord = word
669	            lastErrorMessage = message
670	            if stopRemaining {
671	                // Authentication, configuration, quota, and rate-limit errors
672	                // affect the remaining queue. Stop before repeating the same
673	                // failing paid request; a later run resumes from saved clips.
674	                stopForFailure()
675	            }
676	        case .cancelled:
677	            break
678	        }
679	    }
680	
681	    private func summary() -> BatchRunSummary {
682	        BatchRunSummary(
683	            analysesGenerated: analysesGenerated,
684	            analysesFailed: analysesFailed,
685	            analysesSkipped: analysesSkipped,
686	            analysesUnattempted: max(0, analysisTotal - analysisProcessed),
687	            audioGenerated: audioGenerated,
688	            audioCached: audioCached,
689	            audioFailed: audioFailed,
690	            audioUnattempted: max(0, audioTotal - audioProcessed)
691	        )
692	    }
693	
694	    private func finish() {
695	        let finalSummary = summary()
696	        if stoppedByFailure {
697	            status = .failed(finalSummary)
698	        } else if userRequestedCancellation || Task.isCancelled {
699	            status = .cancelled(finalSummary)
700	        } else {
701	            status = .finished(finalSummary)
702	        }
703	        task = nil
704	    }
705	
706	    private func stopForFailure() {
707	        stoppedByFailure = true
708	        task?.cancel()
709	    }
710	}

1	//
2	//  WordExplanationCacheStore.swift
3	//  SwiftMandarin
4	//
5	//  Persistent cache for AI-generated word explanations. Generating an
6	//  explanation is slow and (for cloud providers) costs API tokens, so once a
7	//  word has been explained the result is stored and re-served instantly the
8	//  next time that word is opened — until the user explicitly regenerates it.
9	//
10	
11	import Foundation
12	import os.log
13	
14	// MARK: - Cached Entry
15	
16	/// One persisted AI word explanation plus the metadata needed to key and label
17	/// it. Entries are keyed by the (normalized word, direction) pair: toggling the
18	/// interface language flips the language the explanation is written in, so a
19	/// per-direction key prevents serving a stale-direction explanation.
20	struct CachedWordExplanation: Codable, Equatable, Sendable {
21	    /// The exact word that was explained (original casing/script preserved for
22	    /// display; matching is done on a normalized form).
23	    let word: String
24	    let pinyin: String
25	    /// Direction token from `ExplanationDirection.cacheToken`
26	    /// (e.g. `"zh>en"` — Chinese word explained in English).
27	    let directionToken: String
28	    /// Display name of the provider that generated this explanation.
29	    let providerName: String
30	    /// When the explanation was generated, shown so the user can judge staleness.
31	    let generatedAt: Date
32	    let result: WordExplanationResult
33	
34	    init(
35	        word: String,
36	        pinyin: String,
37	        directionToken: String,
38	        providerName: String,
39	        generatedAt: Date,
40	        result: WordExplanationResult
41	    ) {
42	        self.word = word
43	        self.pinyin = pinyin
44	        self.directionToken = directionToken
45	        self.providerName = providerName
46	        self.generatedAt = generatedAt
47	        self.result = result
48	    }
49	
50	    private enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {
51	        case word, pinyin, directionToken, providerName, generatedAt, result
52	    }
53	
54	    /// Tolerant decode: only `word` and `result` are essential. A payload
55	    /// written by an older build (missing a field added later) still loads with
56	    /// sensible defaults instead of failing — and one bad field never discards
57	    /// the rest of the entry.
58	    init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {
59	        let container = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
60	        word = try container.decode(String.self, forKey: .word)
61	        result = try container.decode(WordExplanationResult.self, forKey: .result)
62	        pinyin = (try? container.decode(String.self, forKey: .pinyin)) ?? ""
63	        directionToken = (try? container.decode(String.self, forKey: .directionToken)) ?? ""
64	        providerName = (try? container.decode(String.self, forKey: .providerName)) ?? ""
65	        generatedAt = (try? container.decode(Date.self, forKey: .generatedAt))
66	            ?? Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 0)
67	    }
68	}
69	
70	// MARK: - Cache Store
71	
72	/// MainActor-isolated cache of word explanations, persisted to a JSON file in
73	/// Application Support. There is **no capacity limit** — every word the user
74	/// analyzes is retained, so a batch run's progress is permanent and the
75	/// "analyzed" count reflects reality rather than a cache ceiling. (An earlier
76	/// version capped this at 400 entries on an MRU basis, which silently evicted
77	/// older analyses and made the batch-progress count stick at 400.)
78	///
79	/// Two design points keep it fast at thousands of entries: the `lookupIndex`
80	/// membership set is maintained incrementally (never rebuilt per mutation), and
81	/// disk writes are coalesced and performed off the main thread.
82	@Observable
83	@MainActor
84	final class WordExplanationCacheStore {
85	    static let shared = WordExplanationCacheStore()
86	
87	    /// All cached explanations. Order is insignificant — lookups go through
88	    /// `lookupIndex` (membership) or a linear scan (single-word reads, rare).
89	    private(set) var entries: [CachedWordExplanation] = []
90	
91	    /// O(1) membership set of `"<directionToken>\u{1}<normalizedWord>"`.
92	    /// Maintained incrementally alongside `entries`: rebuilding it on every
93	    /// mutation would make a batch over N words O(N²) and saturate the main
94	    /// thread. Observed (not ignored) so the live "remaining" count updates as
95	    /// analyses are stored.
96	    private var lookupIndex: Set<String> = []
97	
98	    /// O(1) membership set of normalized headwords across ALL directions, so
99	    /// "does this word have any analysis?" (used by the export count) is O(1)
100	    /// instead of an O(entries) scan per term.
101	    private var normalizedWordIndex: Set<String> = []
102	
103	    /// Legacy UserDefaults key, read once at launch to migrate into the file.
104	    private let legacyDefaultsKey = "wordExplanationCache"
105	    /// On-disk JSON store in Application Support.
106	    private let fileName = "word-explanation-cache.json"
107	
108	    /// Coalesced + throttled single-writer persistence: a running write task
109	    /// drains `needsWrite`, collapsing bursts of mutations into at most one
110	    /// off-main write per `writeThrottle` while still guaranteeing the final
111	    /// state reaches disk. Throttling matters because a batch over thousands of
112	    /// words re-encodes the whole (growing) file each write — without it that is
113	    /// O(n²) bytes of disk I/O.
114	    private var writeTask: Task<Void, Never>?
115	    private var needsWrite = false
116	    private static let writeThrottle: Duration = .seconds(10)
117	
118	    nonisolated private static let log = Logger(subsystem: "com.rogerlin.SwiftMandarin", category: "WordExplanationCache")
119	
120	    private init() {
121	        load()
122	    }
123	
124	    // MARK: Queries
125	
126	    var count: Int { entries.count }
127	    var isEmpty: Bool { entries.isEmpty }
128	
129	    private static func lookupKey(directionToken: String, word: String) -> String {
130	        "\(directionToken)\u{1}\(normalizedKey(word))"
131	    }
132	
133	    private func rebuildLookupIndex() {
134	        lookupIndex = Set(entries.map { Self.lookupKey(directionToken: $0.directionToken, word: $0.word) })
135	        normalizedWordIndex = Set(entries.map { Self.normalizedKey($0.word) })
136	    }
137	
138	    /// Return a cached explanation for `word` in the given direction, if one
139	    /// exists. Matching ignores invisible characters and surrounding
140	    /// whitespace, and is case-insensitive (English headwords).
141	    func explanation(forWord word: String, directionToken: String) -> CachedWordExplanation? {
142	        let key = Self.normalizedKey(word)
143	        return entries.first {
144	            $0.directionToken == directionToken && Self.normalizedKey($0.word) == key
145	        }
146	    }
147	
148	    /// Whether an explanation is cached for `word` in the given direction.
149	    /// O(1) via `lookupIndex` — this is the batch hot path.
150	    func hasExplanation(forWord word: String, directionToken: String) -> Bool {
151	        lookupIndex.contains(Self.lookupKey(directionToken: directionToken, word: word))
152	    }
153	
154	    /// Every cached explanation whose headword matches any of `words` (across
155	    /// all directions). Used by export to bundle a term's AI analysis: a term's
156	    /// explanation may be stored under either learning-direction headword, so
157	    /// callers pass all candidate forms (see `SavedTerm.aiCacheCandidateWords`).
158	    func explanations(forWords words: [String]) -> [CachedWordExplanation] {
159	        let keys = Set(words.map(Self.normalizedKey)).subtracting([""])
160	        guard !keys.isEmpty else { return [] }
161	        return entries.filter { keys.contains(Self.normalizedKey($0.word)) }
162	    }
163	
164	    /// Whether any of `words` has a cached explanation in any direction. O(1) per
165	    /// word via `normalizedWordIndex` — used by the export count, which would
166	    /// otherwise scan all entries once per term.
167	    func hasAnyExplanation(forWords words: [String]) -> Bool {
168	        for word in words {
169	            let key = Self.normalizedKey(word)
170	            if !key.isEmpty && normalizedWordIndex.contains(key) { return true }
171	        }
172	        return false
173	    }
174	
175	    // MARK: Mutations
176	
177	    /// Insert or replace the explanation for `(word, directionToken)`. A new
178	    /// word is appended (O(1) — the batch hot path); re-analyzing an existing
179	    /// word replaces it in place. There is no capacity trimming.
180	    func store(
181	        word: String,
182	        pinyin: String,
183	        directionToken: String,
184	        providerName: String,
185	        result: WordExplanationResult,
186	        generatedAt: Date = Date()
187	    ) {
188	        let entry = CachedWordExplanation(
189	            word: word,
190	            pinyin: pinyin,
191	            directionToken: directionToken,
192	            providerName: providerName,
193	            generatedAt: generatedAt,
194	            result: result
195	        )
196	        upsert(entry)
197	        scheduleSave()
198	    }
199	
200	    /// Merge imported explanations into the cache in a single pass (one save).
201	    /// Each incoming entry replaces any existing entry with the same
202	    /// (word, direction) key. Used by vocabulary import so a restore of N
203	    /// analyses costs one write, not N.
204	    func merge(_ incoming: [CachedWordExplanation]) {
205	        guard !incoming.isEmpty else { return }
206	        for entry in incoming {
207	            upsert(entry)
208	        }
209	        scheduleSave()
210	    }
211	
212	    /// Insert `entry`, or replace the existing entry with the same
213	    /// (word, direction) key in place, keeping `lookupIndex` in lockstep. Does
214	    /// not persist — callers invoke `scheduleSave()` once after a batch of
215	    /// upserts.
216	    private func upsert(_ entry: CachedWordExplanation) {
217	        let lk = Self.lookupKey(directionToken: entry.directionToken, word: entry.word)
218	        if lookupIndex.contains(lk) {
219	            let key = Self.normalizedKey(entry.word)
220	            if let idx = entries.firstIndex(where: {
221	                $0.directionToken == entry.directionToken && Self.normalizedKey($0.word) == key
222	            }) {
223	                entries[idx] = entry
224	                return
225	            }
226	        }
227	        entries.append(entry)
228	        lookupIndex.insert(lk)
229	        normalizedWordIndex.insert(Self.normalizedKey(entry.word))
230	    }
231	
232	    /// Remove the cached explanation for a specific word+direction (e.g. when
233	    /// its saved term is deleted).
234	    func remove(word: String, directionToken: String) {
235	        let key = Self.normalizedKey(word)
236	        let updated = entries.filter {
237	            !($0.directionToken == directionToken && Self.normalizedKey($0.word) == key)
238	        }
239	        guard updated.count != entries.count else { return }
240	        entries = updated
241	        rebuildLookupIndex()
242	        scheduleSave()
243	    }
244	
245	    /// Remove every cached explanation for `word`, regardless of direction.
246	    func removeAll(forWord word: String) {
247	        let key = Self.normalizedKey(word)
248	        let updated = entries.filter { Self.normalizedKey($0.word) != key }
249	        guard updated.count != entries.count else { return }
250	        entries = updated
251	        rebuildLookupIndex()
252	        scheduleSave()
253	    }
254	
255	    func clear() {
256	        guard !entries.isEmpty else { return }
257	        entries = []
258	        lookupIndex = []
259	        normalizedWordIndex = []
260	        scheduleSave()
261	    }
262	
263	    // MARK: Private
264	
265	    /// Normalize a word for cache lookup: strip zero-width characters and BOM
266	    /// (AI/OCR sources attach these), trim whitespace, and lowercase so English
267	    /// headwords match regardless of capitalization.
268	    private static func normalizedKey(_ s: String) -> String {
269	        String(s.unicodeScalars.filter { ![0x200B, 0x200C, 0x200D, 0xFEFF].contains($0.value) })
270	            .trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
271	            .lowercased()
272	    }
273	
274	    // MARK: Persistence (file-backed, coalesced, off the main thread)
275	
276	    /// Request a persist. Encoding the (potentially large) entries array and
277	    /// writing it happen off the main thread; writes are coalesced so a batch
278	    /// that stores thousands of words doesn't re-encode the file thousands of
279	    /// times on the main actor.
280	    private func scheduleSave() {
281	        needsWrite = true
282	        guard writeTask == nil else { return }
283	        writeTask = Task { [weak self] in
284	            guard let self else { return }
285	            while self.needsWrite {
286	                self.needsWrite = false
287	                let snapshot = self.entries      // value-type COW snapshot (cheap)
288	                let name = self.fileName
289	                // Encode + write off the main actor; only Sendable values cross.
290	                _ = await Task.detached(priority: .utility) {
291	                    Self.writeToDisk(snapshot, fileName: name)
292	                }.value
293	                // Throttle: if more mutations arrived, wait so a burst (e.g. a
294	                // batch run) coalesces into one write per interval instead of
295	                // re-encoding the whole growing file per word. A trailing write
296	                // always follows the last mutation, so nothing is lost.
297	                if self.needsWrite {
298	                    try? await Task.sleep(for: Self.writeThrottle)
299	                }
300	            }
301	            self.writeTask = nil
302	        }
303	    }
304	
305	    /// Encode and atomically write the cache. Returns whether it succeeded, so
306	    /// the migration can avoid deleting its source on a failed write.
307	    @discardableResult
308	    nonisolated private static func writeToDisk(_ entries: [CachedWordExplanation], fileName: String) -> Bool {
309	        guard let url = PersistentCodableStore.appSupportFileURL(fileName) else { return false }
310	        do {
311	            let data = try JSONEncoder().encode(entries)
312	            try data.write(to: url, options: .atomic)
313	            return true
314	        } catch {
315	            // The cache is regenerable; a failed write just means a word may be
316	            // re-analyzed later. Don't crash or block on it.
317	            log.error("WordExplanationCache write failed: \(error.localizedDescription, privacy: .public)")
318	            return false
319	        }
320	    }
321	
322	    private func load() {
323	        // Preferred: the file-backed store.
324	        if let loaded = PersistentCodableStore.loadArrayFromFile([CachedWordExplanation].self, fileName: fileName) {
325	            entries = loaded
326	            rebuildLookupIndex()
327	            return
328	        }
329	        // One-time migration from the old UserDefaults-backed cache (≤ the old
330	        // 400-entry cap). Adopt it, write it to the file, and only when that
331	        // write succeeds clear the UserDefaults keys — otherwise leave them so
332	        // the migration retries next launch rather than losing the data.
333	        if let legacy = PersistentCodableStore.load([CachedWordExplanation].self, key: legacyDefaultsKey) {

338	                UserDefaults.standard.removeObject(forKey: legacyDefaultsKey + ".backup")

12	struct SavedTerm: Identifiable, Codable, Equatable, Hashable {
13	    let id: UUID
14	    let chinese: String
15	    let pinyin: String
16	    let definition: String
17	    let partOfSpeech: String
18	    let dateAdded: Date
19	    var sortOrder: Int
20	    var isMastered: Bool
21	    
22	    init(
23	        id: UUID = UUID(),
24	        chinese: String,
25	        pinyin: String,
26	        definition: String,
27	        partOfSpeech: String = "",
28	        dateAdded: Date = Date(),
29	        sortOrder: Int = 0,
30	        isMastered: Bool = false
31	    ) {
32	        self.id = id
33	        self.chinese = chinese
34	        self.pinyin = pinyin
35	        self.definition = definition
36	        self.partOfSpeech = partOfSpeech
37	        self.dateAdded = dateAdded
38	        self.sortOrder = sortOrder
39	        self.isMastered = isMastered
40	    }
41	
42	    private enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {
43	        case id, chinese, pinyin, definition, partOfSpeech, dateAdded, sortOrder, isMastered
44	    }
45	
46	    /// Tolerant decoder: a missing or malformed field falls back to a default
47	    /// rather than throwing and dropping the whole saved term.
48	    init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {
49	        let c = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
50	        id = (try? c.decode(UUID.self, forKey: .id)) ?? UUID()
51	        chinese = (try? c.decode(String.self, forKey: .chinese)) ?? ""
52	        pinyin = (try? c.decode(String.self, forKey: .pinyin)) ?? ""
53	        definition = (try? c.decode(String.self, forKey: .definition)) ?? ""
54	        partOfSpeech = (try? c.decode(String.self, forKey: .partOfSpeech)) ?? ""
55	        dateAdded = (try? c.decode(Date.self, forKey: .dateAdded)) ?? Date()
56	        sortOrder = (try? c.decode(Int.self, forKey: .sortOrder)) ?? 0
57	        isMastered = (try? c.decode(Bool.self, forKey: .isMastered)) ?? false
58	    }
59	}

61	// MARK: - Interface-language-aware display
62	
63	/// The `chinese` field is really a *headword*: photo-extraction and workbook
64	/// flows store English headwords there when the user is learning English. So
65	/// the two display sides are detected from content, and which side is the big
66	/// headline follows the interface language (= the user's native language):
67	/// 中文 UI → learning English → English is the headline, Mandarin the gloss;
68	/// English UI → learning Mandarin → Chinese headline + pinyin, English gloss.
69	extension SavedTerm {
70	
71	    /// The Chinese side of the entry (headword preferred, else definition).
72	    var chineseSide: String {
73	        if chinese.containsCJK { return chinese }
74	        if definition.containsCJK { return definition }
75	        return ""
76	    }
77	
78	    /// The English side of the entry (headword preferred, else definition).
79	    var englishSide: String {
80	        if !chinese.containsCJK, !chinese.isEmpty { return chinese }
81	        if !definition.containsCJK { return definition }
82	        return ""
83	    }
84	
85	    /// The text shown big — the side in the language the user is learning.
86	    ///
87	    /// A one-sided entry (saved before the learner switched direction, or
88	    /// captured with only a headword) has nothing in the studied language. It
89	    /// still has to render *something*, so the other side is promoted rather
90	    /// than leaving a blank row — and `glossText` then correctly returns "",
91	    /// because the promoted text is already on screen.
92	    @MainActor
93	    var headlineText: String {
94	        let context = LearningContext.current
95	        let primary = context.primary(chinese: chineseSide, english: englishSide)
96	        guard primary.isEmpty else { return primary }
97	        let fallback = context.secondary(chinese: chineseSide, english: englishSide)
98	        return fallback.isEmpty ? chinese : fallback
99	    }
100	
101	    /// The small secondary text — the side in the user's native language.
102	    /// Empty when the entry has nothing beyond the headline.
103	    @MainActor
104	    var glossText: String {
105	        let secondary = LearningContext.current.secondary(chinese: chineseSide, english: englishSide)
106	        return secondary == headlineText ? "" : secondary
107	    }
108	
109	    /// Pinyin is a learner aid for reading Chinese: shown only when the user
110	    /// is learning Chinese (English UI) and the entry has a Chinese side.
111	    ///
112	    /// The mirror aid — an English pronunciation for a Mandarin speaker — is
113	    /// `showsPhonetic`, since the two are never useful at the same time.
114	    @MainActor
115	    var showsPinyin: Bool {
116	        LearningContext.current.showsPinyinAffordances && !chineseSide.isEmpty && !pinyin.isEmpty
117	    }
118	
119	    /// Whether the stored reading should be shown as an English pronunciation
120	    /// under an English headword.
121	    ///
122	    /// In reverse mode the AI fills the same `pinyin` slot with IPA (see
123	    /// `AIExplanationPromptBuilder`), so no new storage is needed — only a
124	    /// rule for when to read it that way. The `looksLikeIPA` guard matters:
125	    /// a term saved while learning Mandarin holds *pinyin* there, and showing
126	    /// "xuéxí" under the headword "study" would be worse than showing nothing.
127	    @MainActor
128	    var showsPhonetic: Bool {
129	        !LearningContext.current.showsPinyinAffordances
130	            && !englishSide.isEmpty
131	            && pinyin.looksLikeIPA
132	            && headlineText == englishSide
133	    }
134	
135	    /// The stored reading, but only when it actually belongs to `headlineText`.
136	    ///
137	    /// One field holds the reading for both directions, so an entry saved
138	    /// while learning Mandarin carries pinyin for its Chinese side. Handing
139	    /// that to an explanation request for the English headword — where it is
140	    /// read as a sense hint — would be misleading noise, and pasting it into a
141	    /// copied English word would be nonsense. Empty when the two don't match.
142	    @MainActor
143	    var headwordReading: String {
144	        if showsPinyin, headlineText == chineseSide { return pinyin }
145	        if showsPhonetic { return pinyin }
146	        return ""
147	    }
148	
149	    /// Headword forms an AI explanation might be cached under. The analyzed word
150	    /// is `headlineText`, which is either side depending on the learning
151	    /// direction at generation time, so export gathers explanations matching any
152	    /// of these (deduplicated, non-empty). Non-isolated so it is usable off the
153	    /// main actor (it reads only content-derived sides, not the interface
154	    /// language).
155	    var aiCacheCandidateWords: [String] {
156	        var seen = Set<String>()
157	        var out: [String] = []
158	        for candidate in [chinese, chineseSide, englishSide] {
159	            let trimmed = candidate.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
160	            guard !trimmed.isEmpty, seen.insert(trimmed).inserted else { continue }
161	            out.append(trimmed)
162	        }
163	        return out
164	    }
165	}

169	@Observable
170	@MainActor
171	final class SavedTermsStore {
172	    static let shared = SavedTermsStore()
173	    
174	    var terms: [SavedTerm] = [] {
175	        didSet { save() }
176	    }
177	    
178	    /// Public accessor for saved terms (alias for terms)
179	    var savedTerms: [SavedTerm] { terms }
180	    
181	    private let saveKey = "savedTerms"
182	    
183	    private init() {
184	        load()
185	    }
186	    
187	    // MARK: - Public Methods
188	
189	    /// Normalize a term for duplicate comparison: AI/OCR sources can attach
190	    /// invisible characters (zero-width space/joiners, BOM) or stray
191	    /// whitespace, which would defeat plain string equality.
192	    ///
193	    /// Case is folded too. Han characters have no case, so this changes
194	    /// nothing for a Mandarin headword — but an English headword captured at
195	    /// the start of a sentence ("Charge") would otherwise be stored a second
196	    /// time alongside the same word met mid-sentence ("charge"). This mirrors
197	    /// `WordExplanationCacheStore`, which already folds case for the same
198	    /// reason.
199	    private static func normalizedKey(_ s: String) -> String {
200	        String(s.unicodeScalars.filter { ![0x200B, 0x200C, 0x200D, 0xFEFF].contains($0.value) })
201	            .trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
202	            .lowercased()
203	    }
204	
205	    func add(_ term: SavedTerm) {
206	        let key = Self.normalizedKey(term.chinese)
207	        guard !terms.contains(where: { Self.normalizedKey($0.chinese) == key }) else { return }
208	        var newTerm = term
209	        newTerm.sortOrder = terms.count
210	        terms.append(newTerm)
211	        // Track activity with part of speech
212	        LearningActivityStore.shared.recordWordLearned(partOfSpeech: term.partOfSpeech)
213	    }
214	
215	    func add(chinese: String, pinyin: String, definition: String, partOfSpeech: String = "") {
216	        let key = Self.normalizedKey(chinese)
217	        guard !terms.contains(where: { Self.normalizedKey($0.chinese) == key }) else { return }
218	
219	        let newTerm = SavedTerm(
220	            chinese: chinese,
221	            pinyin: pinyin,
222	            definition: definition,
223	            partOfSpeech: partOfSpeech,
224	            sortOrder: terms.count
225	        )
226	        terms.append(newTerm)
227	        // Track activity with part of speech
228	        LearningActivityStore.shared.recordWordLearned(partOfSpeech: partOfSpeech)
229	    }
230	    
231	    func remove(at offsets: IndexSet) {
232	        var updated = terms
233	        let removed = offsets.compactMap { terms.indices.contains($0) ? terms[$0] : nil }
234	        updated.remove(atOffsets: offsets)
235	        terms = reindexed(updated)
236	        purgeProgress(for: removed)
237	    }
238	
239	    func remove(_ term: SavedTerm) {
240	        terms = reindexed(terms.filter { $0.id != term.id })
241	        purgeProgress(for: [term])
242	    }
243	
244	    func remove(chinese: String) {
245	        let key = Self.normalizedKey(chinese)
246	        let removed = terms.filter { Self.normalizedKey($0.chinese) == key }
247	        terms = reindexed(terms.filter { Self.normalizedKey($0.chinese) != key })
248	        purgeProgress(for: removed)
249	    }
250	
251	    func term(withID id: UUID) -> SavedTerm? {
252	        terms.first { $0.id == id }
253	    }
254	
255	    /// Replace a stored term. Returns `false` when the term no longer exists
256	    /// (e.g. it was deleted while a detail view held a stale copy), so callers
257	    /// can surface the failure instead of silently dropping the edit.
258	    @discardableResult
259	    func update(_ updatedTerm: SavedTerm) -> Bool {
260	        guard let index = terms.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == updatedTerm.id }) else { return false }
261	
262	        var replacement = updatedTerm
263	        replacement.sortOrder = terms[index].sortOrder
264	        terms[index] = replacement
265	        return true
266	    }
267	    
268	    func move(from source: Int, to destination: Int) {
269	        var updated = terms
270	        updated.move(fromOffsets: IndexSet(integer: source), toOffset: destination)
271	        terms = reindexed(updated)
272	    }
273	    
274	    func contains(chinese: String) -> Bool {
275	        let key = Self.normalizedKey(chinese)
276	        return terms.contains { Self.normalizedKey($0.chinese) == key }
277	    }
278	    
279	    func clear() {
280	        let removed = terms
281	        terms.removeAll()
282	        purgeProgress(for: removed)
283	    }
284	    
285	    /// Toggle the mastered status of a term
286	    func toggleMastered(_ term: SavedTerm) {
287	        guard let index = terms.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == term.id }) else { return }
288	        terms[index].isMastered.toggle()
289	    }
290	    
291	    /// Set the mastered status of a term
292	    func setMastered(_ term: SavedTerm, isMastered: Bool) {
293	        guard let index = terms.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == term.id }) else { return }
294	        terms[index].isMastered = isMastered
295	    }
296	    
297	    /// Count of mastered terms
298	    var masteredCount: Int {
299	        terms.filter { $0.isMastered }.count
300	    }
301	    
302	    // MARK: - Private Methods
303	
304	    /// Purge the SRS review progress of removed terms. Vocabulary cards are
305	    /// keyed "vocab:<uuid>" in `LearningProgressStore`, so without this a
306	    /// deleted word would leave an orphaned card that keeps resurfacing in
307	    /// due/review queues forever.
308	    private func purgeProgress(for removed: [SavedTerm]) {
309	        for term in removed {
310	            LearningProgressStore.shared.removeProgress(forCardId: "vocab:\(term.id.uuidString)")
311	        }
312	    }
313	
314	    /// Return a copy of `terms` with `sortOrder` renumbered to match array
315	    /// position. Callers assign the result to `terms` in a single statement so
316	    /// the `didSet` persistence hook fires exactly once. Renumbering in place
317	    /// (`terms[i].sortOrder = i` in a loop) instead triggers `save()` for every
318	    /// row, turning one delete into an O(n²) synchronous JSON-encode +
319	    /// UserDefaults write storm that freezes the UI on large lists.
320	    private func reindexed(_ source: [SavedTerm]) -> [SavedTerm] {
321	        var result = source
322	        for index in result.indices {
323	            result[index].sortOrder = index
324	        }
325	        return result
326	    }
327	    
328	    private func save() {
329	        PersistentCodableStore.save(terms, key: saveKey)
330	    }
331	
332	    private func load() {
333	        if let decoded = PersistentCodableStore.load([SavedTerm].self, key: saveKey) {
334	            terms = decoded.sorted { $0.sortOrder < $1.sortOrder }
335	        }
336	    }
337	}

#!/bin/zsh

set -euo pipefail

repo_root="${0:A:h:h}"
binary_path="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/swiftmandarin-learning-direction-checks"

# The opt-in flag leaves the external runner inert if Xcode ever sees it as an
# app source. It also compiles out `LearningContext.current`, the one accessor
# that reaches into app state, so the mirror logic can be checked on its own.
DEVELOPER_DIR="${DEVELOPER_DIR:-/Applications/Xcode-beta.app/Contents/Developer}" \
    xcrun swiftc \
    "$repo_root/SwiftMandarin/Models/LearningContext.swift" \
    "$repo_root/scripts/learning-direction-checks/LearningDirectionChecksRunner.swift" \
    -D LEARNING_DIRECTION_CHECKS \
    -swift-version 6 \
    -strict-concurrency=complete \
    -warnings-as-errors \
    -parse-as-library \
    -o "$binary_path"

"$binary_path"

# Reversal is only real if the app actually asks. These greps fail loudly when a
# surface that must mirror stops consulting the learning direction — the exact
# regression that leaves the reverse mode half-applied.
count_matches() {
    local pattern="$1"
    shift
    { rg -o -- "$pattern" "$@" || true; } | wc -l | tr -d ' '
}

# The vocabulary list must size and order the row by the studied language, and
# must offer the English pronunciation where pinyin does not apply.
vocab_headword=$(count_matches 'renderedHeadwordFontSize' "$repo_root/SwiftMandarin/Views/VocabularyView.swift")
vocab_phonetic=$(count_matches 'term\.showsPhonetic' "$repo_root/SwiftMandarin/Views/VocabularyView.swift")
[[ "$vocab_headword" -ge 2 ]] || {
    print -u2 "The vocabulary row no longer sizes the headword by its language; found $vocab_headword"
    exit 1
}
[[ "$vocab_phonetic" -ge 3 ]] || {
    print -u2 "The vocabulary list/detail views no longer show an English pronunciation; found $vocab_phonetic"
    exit 1
}

# The tappable reader must follow the learner, not the content.
translate_reader=$(count_matches 'interactiveReaderIsChinese' "$repo_root/SwiftMandarin/Views/TranslateView.swift")
translate_english_ruby=$(count_matches 'EnglishRubyTextView\(' "$repo_root/SwiftMandarin/Views/TranslateView.swift")
[[ "$translate_reader" -ge 4 ]] || {
    print -u2 "Translate no longer picks its interactive pane by learning direction; found $translate_reader"
    exit 1
}
[[ "$translate_english_ruby" == "1" ]] || {
    print -u2 "Translate no longer offers the English word-by-word reader; found $translate_english_ruby"
    exit 1
}

# Pinyin ruby is scaffolding for a Mandarin learner only.
ruby_gate=$(count_matches 'showPinyin && localization\.learningIsChinese' "$repo_root/SwiftMandarin/Views/Components/RubyTextView.swift")
[[ "$ruby_gate" == "1" ]] || {

3	//  SwiftMandarin
4	//
5	//  Manages AI provider settings and preferences. Supports Apple Intelligence
6	//  (Foundation Models), local Ollama, and a family of cloud providers
7	//  (OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Deepseek, Doubao, Qwen, Kimi, Zhipu, Minimax)

14	// MARK: - Provider API Style
15	
16	/// The request/response convention a cloud provider uses.
17	enum AIProviderAPIStyle {
18	    /// OpenAI `/chat/completions` + `/models`, `Authorization: Bearer` auth.
19	    case openAICompatible
20	    /// Anthropic `/v1/messages` + `/v1/models`, `x-api-key` + `anthropic-version`.
21	    case anthropic
22	}
23	
24	// MARK: - AI Provider
25	
26	/// The AI provider to use for AI-powered features.
27	enum AIProvider: String, CaseIterable, Identifiable, Codable {
28	    case appleIntelligence = "apple"
29	    case ollama = "ollama"
30	    case openAI = "openai"

477	    /// Store or clear a cloud provider's API key (Keychain + observable mirror).
478	    func setAPIKey(_ value: String, for provider: AIProvider) {
479	        let trimmed = value.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
480	        let previous = apiKeys[provider.rawValue] ?? ""
481	        KeychainHelper.set(trimmed, account: provider.keychainAccount)
482	        if trimmed.isEmpty {
483	            apiKeys.removeValue(forKey: provider.rawValue)
484	        } else {
485	            apiKeys[provider.rawValue] = trimmed
486	        }
487	        if provider == .minimax, previous != trimmed {
488	            // MiniMax text and AI Audio intentionally share one Keychain key.
489	            // Invalidate credential-scoped live voice metadata regardless of
490	            // which Settings surface changed that shared credential.
491	            MiniMaxAudioCatalogStore.shared.activateSharedCredential(apiKey: trimmed)
492	            AppPreferences.shared.invalidateCredentialScopedVoiceProvenance()
493	            BatchExplanationController.shared.cancel()
494	        }
495	    }

75	/// Observable, app-wide controller for the in-app UI language.
76	///
77	/// Changing `language` persists the choice, repoints `Bundle.main` at the
78	/// matching `.lproj`, and (because it is `@Observable`) drives a SwiftUI
79	/// refresh wherever the value is read — see `SwiftMandarinApp` which keys the
80	/// root view's identity to it.
81	@Observable
82	@MainActor
83	final class LocalizationManager {
84	
85	    static let shared = LocalizationManager()
86	
87	    private enum Keys {
88	        static let appLanguage = "app_language"
89	    }
90	
91	    /// The active UI language. Setting it persists the choice and updates the
92	    /// active localization bundle so subsequent string lookups switch over.
93	    /// The interface language doubles as the user's NATIVE language, so the
94	    /// learner-mode preference is kept in sync: a 中文 interface means a native
95	    /// Mandarin speaker learning English, and vice versa.
96	    var language: AppLanguage {
97	        didSet {
98	            guard oldValue != language else { return }
99	            UserDefaults.standard.set(language.rawValue, forKey: Keys.appLanguage)
100	            Bundle.setLanguageOverride(language.rawValue)
101	            AppPreferences.shared.syncLearnerMode(toInterfaceLanguage: language)
102	        }
103	    }
104	
105	    /// The interface language is treated as the user's native language.
106	    var nativeIsChinese: Bool { language == .chinese }
107	
108	    /// The language the user is learning — always the opposite of the UI
109	    /// language (中文 UI → learning English; English UI → learning Mandarin).
110	    var learningIsChinese: Bool { language == .english }
111	
112	    /// Locale to inject into the SwiftUI environment so number/date/plural
113	    /// formatting matches the chosen UI language.
114	    var locale: Locale { language.locale }
115	
116	    private init() {
117	        let saved = UserDefaults.standard.string(forKey: Keys.appLanguage)
118	        let initial = saved.flatMap(AppLanguage.init(rawValue:)) ?? Self.systemDefault()
119	        self.language = initial
120	        // Apply immediately so the very first frame already renders in the
121	        // selected language (this runs at app construction, before any view).
122	        Bundle.setLanguageOverride(initial.rawValue)
123	    }
124	
125	    /// First-launch default: follow the device language when it is Chinese,
126	    /// otherwise fall back to English.
127	    private static func systemDefault() -> AppLanguage {
128	        let preferred = Locale.preferredLanguages.first ?? "en"
129	        return preferred.lowercased().hasPrefix("zh") ? .chinese : .english
130	    }

[[ "$ruby_gate" == "1" ]] || {
    print -u2 "Pinyin ruby is no longer gated on the learning direction; found $ruby_gate"
    exit 1
}

# A first launch must open on the direction the learner mode implies.
persisted_default=$(count_matches '(TranslationDirection)?\.persistedDefault' \
    "$repo_root/SwiftMandarin/Views/TranslateView.swift" \
    "$repo_root/SwiftMandarin/Views/MoreView.swift" \
    "$repo_root/SwiftMandarin/Views/MacOSSettingsView.swift" \
    "$repo_root/SwiftMandarin/Models/TranslationState.swift")
[[ "$persisted_default" == "4" ]] || {
    print -u2 "A reader of the default direction still hard-codes English→Chinese; found $persisted_default of 4"
    exit 1
}

# Switching the interface language re-classes `Bundle.main` so its ObjC
# `localizedString(forKey:value:table:)` resolves against the chosen `.lproj`.
# SwiftUI's `Text("…")` goes through that method; `String(localized:)` does NOT
# — it uses Foundation's own lookup and silently follows the DEVICE language.
# Every assembled string must therefore name the bundle explicitly, or half the
# interface stays in the wrong language with no compiler complaint.
# `grep -v` exits non-zero when it filters every line away, which under
# `pipefail` would abort the script exactly when the check is passing — so the
# scan is wrapped to always succeed and judged on its output instead.
unrouted_sites() {
    { rg -n --glob '!**/LocalizationManager.swift' --glob '!**/LanguageBundleOverride.swift' \
        'String\(localized:' "$repo_root/SwiftMandarin" || true; } \
        | { grep -v 'bundle: \.appLanguage' || true; } \
        | { grep -v 'String(localized: audioPlan' || true; } \
        | { grep -vE '^[^:]+:[0-9]+:[[:space:]]*///' || true; }
}

unrouted=$(unrouted_sites | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
[[ "$unrouted" == "0" ]] || {
    print -u2 "A String(localized:) call bypasses the in-app language override ($unrouted site(s)):"
    unrouted_sites | head -5
    exit 1
}

# Foundation declares init(localized:table:bundle:locale:comment:), so a
# `comment:` written before `bundle:` is an argument-order error rather than a
# style nit — it fails the build outright.
bad_order=$({ rg -n 'comment:[^)]*bundle: \.appLanguage' "$repo_root/SwiftMandarin" || true; } | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
[[ "$bad_order" == "0" ]] || {
    print -u2 "A String(localized:) call passes comment: before bundle: ($bad_order site(s))"
    exit 1
}

print "Learning direction wiring checks passed (8/8)"

1	//
2	//  LearningContext.swift
3	//  SwiftMandarin
4	//
5	//  One place to answer the questions every bilingual surface keeps asking:
6	//  which side of an English/Chinese pair is the learner studying, which side
7	//  do they already read, and which learner aids (pinyin, tone colors, the
8	//  tappable ruby reader) are meaningful at all.
9	//
10	//  Why this exists
11	//  ---------------
12	//  The app is a mirror: an English speaker learning Mandarin and a Mandarin
13	//  speaker learning English get the same features with the two languages
14	//  swapped. Before this type, that swap was re-derived inline at every call
15	//  site from `LocalizationManager.shared.learningIsChinese`, which made it
16	//  easy to reverse the *text* while forgetting the *pinyin affordance* or the
17	//  *word-by-word reader* that goes with it. Deriving them all from one value
18	//  keeps the two directions genuinely symmetric.
19	//
20	//  The core is a pure, `Sendable`, Foundation-only value so the mirror
21	//  property — "every accessor of the reversed context equals the swapped
22	//  accessor of the forward one" — can be asserted by the standalone contract
23	//  runner in `scripts/learning-direction-checks/` without a UI, a bundle, or
24	//  a main actor.
25	//
26	
27	import Foundation
28	
29	// MARK: - Learning Context (pure)
30	
31	/// The resolved language roles for one learner. `learningIsChinese` is the
32	/// only stored fact; everything else is that fact projected onto a specific
33	/// question a view or model needs answered.
34	nonisolated struct LearningContext: Equatable, Sendable {
35	
36	    /// Whether Mandarin is the language being *studied*. When false the user
37	    /// is a Mandarin speaker studying English and every pair is reversed.
38	    let learningIsChinese: Bool
39	
40	    init(learningIsChinese: Bool) {
41	        self.learningIsChinese = learningIsChinese
42	    }
43	
44	    /// The user's native language is always the other one.
45	    var nativeIsChinese: Bool { !learningIsChinese }
46	
47	    /// The same learner with the two languages swapped. Used by the contract
48	    /// checks to assert the two directions really are mirror images.
49	    var mirrored: LearningContext {
50	        LearningContext(learningIsChinese: !learningIsChinese)
51	    }
52	
53	    // MARK: Text selection
54	
55	    /// The side shown big — the language being studied.
56	    func primary(chinese: String, english: String) -> String {
57	        learningIsChinese ? chinese : english
58	    }
59	
60	    /// The side shown small — the language the user already reads.
61	    func secondary(chinese: String, english: String) -> String {
62	        learningIsChinese ? english : chinese
63	    }
64	
65	    // MARK: Learner aids
66	
67	    /// Pinyin, tone marks, tone colors, and tone drills teach the *reading* of
68	    /// Chinese. They are learner scaffolding, so they belong only to the
69	    /// learner who is decoding Chinese — a native Mandarin reader studying
70	    /// English needs none of them on their own language.
71	    var showsPinyinAffordances: Bool { learningIsChinese }
72	
73	    /// Whether the tappable word-by-word reader should segment Chinese
74	    /// (`RubyTextView`) rather than English (`EnglishRubyTextView`).
75	    var interactiveReaderIsChinese: Bool { learningIsChinese }
76	}
77	
78	// MARK: - Live resolution
79	
80	// This is the only part of the file that touches app state. It is compiled out
81	// of the standalone contract runner (which defines `LEARNING_DIRECTION_CHECKS`)
82	// so the pure mirror logic above can be verified without dragging in
83	// `LocalizationManager` and everything it depends on. Xcode never defines that
84	// flag, so the app always gets this extension.
85	#if !LEARNING_DIRECTION_CHECKS
86	extension LearningContext {
87	
88	    /// The context implied by the current interface language. The interface
89	    /// language *is* the user's native language (see `LocalizationManager`),
90	    /// so one read answers the whole question.
91	    @MainActor
92	    static var current: LearningContext {
93	        LearningContext(learningIsChinese: LocalizationManager.shared.learningIsChinese)
94	    }
95	}
96	#endif
